title: Add a clamp operation
description: Add Arithmetic.clamp(_:to:) and cover values below, inside, and above a closed integer range.
design: Edit Sources/DispatchTestbed/Arithmetic.swift and Tests/DispatchTestbedTests/ArithmeticTests.swift. Keep the implementation deterministic and dependency-free.
acceptance_criteria: mise run test passes; clamp returns the lower bound below the range, the original value inside it, and the upper bound above it.
